t: The Bulldozer Pro Floor Squeegee is engineered for demanding tasks, efficiently removing excess water and spillages. This robust 18" (457mm) squeegee is also ideal for screeding and levelling various compounds, including cement, sand and grout. Features a durable rubber blade and wooden head, and a heavy-duty double-lock support bracket. Sturdy steel handle provides stability, complemented by a soft handle grip for comfortable operation. The integrated handle clip allows for convenient, compact storage of this essential cleaning and levelling tool.
b: Durable Rubber Blade for Effective Water Removal
Sturdy Steel Handle for Optimal Control
Soft Handle Grip for Comfort During Extended Use
Integrated Handle Clip for Compact Storage
